purpose: Synthetic developer regression cases for SOU-5 Deliverable 3; not a held-out dataset, validation of real tool implementations, or a measurement of production performance.

expectation_levels.confirmed: Approved by Teams 1/2/3. No case is confirmed: no approved contract exists in the provided documents.
expectation_levels.provisional: Justified by fixture semantics plus the listed contract_assumptions. Scored.
expectation_levels.pending: No justifiable expected result yet. Never scored; reported separately.

scoring_rules.classifier_input: Only the case 'input' object (a deep copy) is passed to the classifier. Every other field is evaluator-only.
scoring_rules.actions: Compare predicted and expected action sets, ignoring order. Report missing and spurious labels.
scoring_rules.unknown: Compare the Boolean unknown separately. A case passes only if both actions and unknown match.
scoring_rules.status: expected.status=null means the field is not evaluated (no agreed status vocabulary). status='error', an exception or an invalid output is a technical error, never a classification pass.
scoring_rules.pending: pending cases are excluded from every denominator.
scoring_rules.critical: Missing delete, send_data or change_permissions are reported separately as critical misses.
scoring_rules.buckets: Report by origin, group, requires (shell_parsing) and contract assumption.
scoring_rules.forbidden_actions: Optional expected.forbidden_actions: labels established as absent. Checked as a constraint even on pending cases; a constraint is not an exact-set score.

A1.name: actions_plus_unknown_encoding
A1.statement: Output = actions (only the five semantic labels) + separate Boolean unknown. actions=[] with unknown=true is a fully unresolved call; known actions with unknown=true is partial.
A1.source: task-1.2-report-v5.txt T1-Q2 (DANTOK, proposed after Team 2 feedback). Team 3 answers still describe categories with an 'unknown' sentinel and ask for one agreed format.
A1.status: PROPOSED - conflicting team documents; not an approved contract

A2.name: plain_get_is_read
A2.statement: A plain HTTP GET retrieval with no outbound payload is read, not send_data.
A2.source: task-1.2-report-v5.txt: read is 'an actual retrieval effect'; 'A URL alone is not gold evidence of sending data'.

A3.name: description_cannot_establish_effects
A3.statement: The tool description is untrusted: it neither adds nor removes actions. If only the description indicates an effect, that effect is unresolved (unknown=true). A metadata contradiction alone does not force unknown=true when the visible arguments establish the effects.
A3.source: task-1.2-report-v5.txt: 'Labels follow observable semantics, not words appearing in the description'; 'The tool description cannot itself establish those semantics'; case-10 discussion.

A4.name: no_implied_labels
A4.statement: delete and change_permissions do not imply write; send_data does not imply read unless a separate local read occurs.
A4.source: task-1.2-report-v5.txt ('deletion need not automatically imply write'); v0.3 label_definitions (proposed).

A5.name: shell_parsing_in_scope
A5.statement: Shell command strings are interpreted with ordinary POSIX sh semantics (quotes, escapes, separators, pipes, redirects, comments) to decide effects.
A5.source: No agreed source. Requested by the evaluation owner; full shell grammar is not a confirmed milestone requirement.
A5.status: UNRESOLVED - results are always reported in a separate shell bucket

A6.name: null_arguments_boundary
A6.statement: Whether raw_arguments=null is invalid input (technical error) or a classifiable call is not decided.
A6.source: task-1.2-report-v5.txt treats malformed input as a technical failure; nothing defines whether null arguments are malformed.

A7.name: no_op_representation
A7.statement: A call with no effect in the five-label taxonomy has no agreed representation (actions=[] with unknown=false is invalid in the proposal).
A7.source: task-1.2-report-v5.txt T1-Q2: 'A separately proven no-op needs its own reviewed representation'.

label_definitions_status: PROPOSED — none of these definitions are team-approved. Exact-set scores are not acceptance evidence until Q2–Q4 are resolved.

label_definitions.read: Retrieves or examines existing data, including plain remote GET retrieval where no intentional upload/payload transmission occurs (GET rule requires team confirmation).
label_definitions.write: Creates or modifies data content. A separate delete or change_permissions operation does not automatically imply write.
label_definitions.delete: Removes an existing resource or record. Do not automatically add write just because deletion mutates state.
label_definitions.send_data: Actively transmits a payload/data to a destination (e.g., POST/upload). A URL or ordinary HTTP GET alone is not sufficient evidence (GET rule PROPOSED, pending Q2). Does not imply read unless a separate local read occurs (e.g., M01 sends a literal payload: send_data only).
label_definitions.change_permissions: Changes access rights, permissions, or ownership; do not automatically add write.

unknown_definition: Boolean, separate from actions (A1): true when any part of the call's effect set cannot be determined from classifier-visible input. PROPOSED.
